title: verdict_contract derives criteria from falsifier clauses
intention: falsifier_criteria builds one criterion per falsifier clause — claim = the clause's claim, source = 'falsifier@<id> clause (n)' — when the ticket's falsifier carries clauses, and reads every standing shape as before.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: cairn/tools/chain/verdict_contract.py:79-80 reads proves_red from a dict falsifier and segments it by regex; a {clauses} falsifier has no proves_red and is refused today as 'carries no falsifier'. The parent e4f02a1ceef5 makes the ticket plan JSON at the cast door (Akien 2026-11-05: 'should be json'); this reader must read the new shape before the door admits it.
traces_to: Law 4 and Law 1 via parent e4f02a1ceef5; RULE 1 (each reader's change lives in its own component).
how: Before the proves_red branch, a dict falsifier carrying a clauses list yields criteria from it directly, refusing (with the standing refusal wording) an empty list, a blank claim or numbering other than 1..k; red-first proof over a scratch ticket root.
falsifier: (1) a scratch ticket with two clauses yields two criteria with claims verbatim and sources 'falsifier@<id> clause (1)' and '(2)'; (2) clauses [] and numbering [2] are each refused with an error naming the ticket; (3) a scratch ticket with a string falsifier '(1) a (2) b' yields what it yields at HEAD.

decisions.text: Red-first proof cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_criteria_come_from_falsifier_clauses.py, check()/FAILURES/main() shape, one tooth per falsifier clause, PROVES = {'e6cac10b0297': {'1': 'clause_1', '2': 'clause_2', '3': 'clause_3', '4': 'clause_4', '5': 'clause_5', '6': 'clause_6', '7': 'clause_7'}} (tooth names written at build, each named for its clause). Red at HEAD on the new-shape teeth.
